extensionBrief.behavior: Provide a keyboard-operable selector for the three supplied samples. Selecting a sample must update visible label, detail and a text state. This is local sample state only: do not make relay, account, inventory or payment requests.
extensionBrief.placement: Render the live feature in the inspection context and show its states and public API alongside the adapted primitives in the styleguide.
extensionBrief.boundary: The evidence establishes Conduit's token roles, voice scale, tabs, button variants and compact Badge treatment. It does not establish that a new shared provenance primitive is warranted. Keep the feature local unless the cook can give concrete evidence for promotion; do not manufacture a prune or promotion decision.

adaptationBoundary: fixtures/upstream/ is an immutable React/TypeScript and Tailwind reference snapshot. static-web-v1 has no React, Wouter, Tailwind build or upstream dependency runtime.
